_comment: WOPR LINE Plugin Configuration - Webhook Mode
description: LINE is webhook-only; this is the standard configuration

line._webhookNote: Set this URL in LINE Developers Console: https://yourdomain.com:3000/webhook
_dmPolicyOptions: allowlist - Only users in allowFrom can DM
line._allowFrom_note: LINE user IDs (U followed by 32 hex chars)
_groupPolicyOptions: allowlist - Only users in groupAllowFrom can trigger
open - Anyone in groups can trigger

_setup_steps.step1: Go to https://developers.line.biz/ and create a Messaging API channel
_setup_steps.step2: Issue a long-lived channel access token
_setup_steps.step3: Copy the channel secret from Basic settings
_setup_steps.step4: Set LINE_CHANNEL_ACCESS_TOKEN and LINE_CHANNEL_SECRET env vars
_setup_steps.step5: Expose this server publicly (ngrok for dev, reverse proxy for prod)
_setup_steps.step6: Set webhook URL in LINE Developers Console to https://yourdomain.com/webhook
_setup_steps.step8: Start WOPR daemon: wopr daemon start
